English Wizard.question: ১) If I had a lot of money, I would definitely do something for the street children. (make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Because of having a lot of money, I would definitely do something for the street children.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Having a lot of money, I would definitely do something for the street children.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Notwithstanding a lot of money, I would definitely do something for the street children.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) In case of having a lot of money, I would definitely do something for the street children.
English Wizard.exp:
Complex Sentence এ If + Affirmative Clause থাকলে Simple করার সময় by/ in case of + Verb + ing বসে।

in case of = ক্ষেত্রে, (কর)লে/(হ)লে
অন্যদিকে,
because of = কারণে
notwithstanding = সত্ত্বেও
বাক্যের অর্থ- আমার অনেক টাকা থাকলে, আমি পথশিশুদের জন্য অবশ্যই কিছু একটা করতাম।

English Wizard.question: ২) You can visit the whole world with much ease in case you learn English properly. (make it compound)
English Wizard.option1: ক) When you learn English properly and then you can visit the whole world with much ease.
English Wizard.option2: খ) You can visit the whole world with much ease but you have to learn English properly.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Learn English properly and you can visit the whole world with much ease.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) You can visit the whole world with much ease and you should learn English properly.
English Wizard.exp:
If/ In case যুক্ত Complex Sentence কে Compound করতে হলে If/ In case যুক্ত Clause কে Imperative Sentence এর গঠনে বাক্যের শুরুতে বসাতে হয়।
অন্য Clause- If Clause এর ফলাফল হলে মাঝখানে and বসবে। তাই এখানে সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।

English Wizard.question: ৩) Which one is not a complex sentence?
English Wizard.option1: ক) The man I met yesterday was a great saint.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The sun having set, we returned home.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He speaks as if he were mad.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Green mangoes are sour if tasted.
English Wizard.exp:
ক- I met yesterday এটা the man – Noun কে Modify করার কারণে Adjective Clause হয়েছে। তাই এখানে একটি Principal Clause (The man was a great saint.) এবং একটি Subordinate Clause (I met yesterday) আছে। তাই বাক্যটি Complex.
খ- এখানে having set – Finite Verb নয়, তাই বাক্যটিতে একটাই Clause (we returned home) আছে। তাই এটা Complex Sentence নয়।
গ- এখানে as if he were mad – speaks -verb কে Modify করছে, বিধায় এটি Adverbial Clause হয়েছে। তাই এখানে একটি Principal Clause (He speaks) এবং একটি Subordinate Clause (as if he were mad) আছে। তাই বাক্যটি Complex.
ঘ- এখানে If tasted একটি Adverbial Clause যার Subject ও Auxiliary Verb কে উহ্য রাখা হয়েছে। মূলত এটা ছিল If they are tasted. Clause টা are – Verb কে Modify করছে। তাই এখানে একটি Principal Clause (Green mangoes are sour) এবং একটি Subordinate Clause (if tasted) আছে। তাই বাক্যটি Complex.

English Wizard.question: ৪) The house belongs _____ Mr. Abedin.
English Wizard.option2: খ) to
English Wizard.option3: গ) for
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) no preposition
English Wizard.exp:
বাড়িটি মি. আবেদীনের অধিকারে আছে।
belong to = অধিকারে থাকা।

English Wizard.question: ৫) The man is devoid _____ common sense.
English Wizard.option2: খ) from
English Wizard.option3: গ) in
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) with
English Wizard.exp:
লোকটি সাধারণ জ্ঞানবিহীন।
devoid of = খালি

English Wizard.question: ৬) Which one is a simple sentence?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Choose only such friends as you can trust.
English Wizard.option3: গ) I made the man carry the load.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He will never return, for he passed away.
English Wizard.exp:
Simple Sentence হচ্ছে যে বাক্যের মধ্যে কেবল একটা Clause থাকে। এখানে (গ) অপশনের বাক্যটা ছাড়া সবগুলোতে ২টা করে Clause আছে। গ-তে carry -verb টা হচ্ছে bare infinitive. এটা Finite Verb নয়।
তাই বাক্যটিতে একটাই Finite Verb (made) আছে, বিধায় বাক্যটিতে একটাই Clause আছে। আর এ জন্য বাক্যটি Simple. বাক্যের অর্থ- আমি লোকটাকে দিয়ে বোঝাটা বহন করালাম।
Do or die. = Compound Sentence
Choose only such friends as you can trust. = Complex Sentence
I made the man carry the load. = Simple Sentence
He will never return, for he passed away. = Compound Sentence

English Wizard.question: ৭) Which sentence is the correct one?
English Wizard.option1: ক) If I was a skylark!
English Wizard.option2: খ) Do you know what is the problem?
English Wizard.option3: গ) Let your opponents to criticize you and you will understand the mistakes.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Who they are is known to all.
English Wizard.exp:
Correct Sentences:
ক- If I was were a skylark! আকাঙ্খা বোঝালে be verb সব সময় were হয়, was হয় না।
খ- Do you know what is the problem is? এখানে Do you know হচ্ছে Principal Clause আর what is the problem হচ্ছে Subordinate Clause. Subordinate Clause সব সময় Assertive Sentence এর গঠনে হয়, তাই এতে Auxiliary Verb Subject এর আগে বসে না।
গ- Let your opponents to criticize you and you will understand the mistakes. Let এর পর সব সময় Bare Infinitive হয়।
ঘ- Who they are is known to all. Who they are – Clause টা এখানে Subject হয়েছে, তাই এটা Subordinate (Noun) Clause. তাই এটাতে Verb Subject এর পরে বসানো ঠিক আছে। এর পর Clause -Subject হলে সেটা Singular হিসেবে বিবেচিত হয়। তাই এর পর is known – Singular Form বসানো শুদ্ধ আছে।

English Wizard.question: ৮) Though he did a lot for the whole family, nobody in the family liked him. (Make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) In spite his doing a lot for the whole family, nobody in the family liked him.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Despite of his doing a lot for the whole family, nobody in the family liked him.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Despite his doing a lot for the whole family, nobody in the family liked him.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Notwithstanding of his doing a lot for the whole family, nobody in the family liked him.
English Wizard.exp:
Complex Sentence এ though থাকলে Simple করার সময় in spite of / despite/ notwithstanding (সত্ত্বেও) বসে।
ক- তে in spite এর পর of নেই।
খ- despite এর পর of বসে না।
ঘ- notwithstanding এর পর of বসে না।
তাই সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।

English Wizard.question: ৯) You must obey me; else I will punish you. What type of sentence is this?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Complex
English Wizard.option3: গ) Compound
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Conditional
English Wizard.exp:
You must obey me এবং I will punish you দুইটাই Independent Clause, একটা আরেকটার Part নয়।
আর এগুলো else (co-ordinate Conjunction) দ্বারা যুক্ত হয়েছে।
তাই বাক্যটা Compound Sentence.

English Wizard.question: ১০) No sooner had the thief seen the police than he ran away. What type of sentence is this?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Compound
English Wizard.option3: গ) Simple
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Complex
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যটিতে ২টি Clause আছে।
একটি Principal Clause (No sooner had the thief seen the police) এবং একটি Subordinate Clause (than he ran away) আছে।
তাই বাক্যটি একটি Complex Sentence.

English Wizard.question: ১১) Had I read the textbook properly, I would not have failed. (make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) In case of having read the textbook properly, I would not have failed.
English Wizard.option2: খ) By having read the textbook properly, I would not have failed.
English Wizard.option3: গ) By reading the textbook properly, I would not have failed.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Without reading the textbook properly, I would not have failed.
English Wizard.exp:
Had I read মূলত If I had read ছিল। If কে এখানে উহ্য রাখা হয়েছে।
If যুক্ত Complex Sentence কে Simple করার সময় If Clause – Affirmative হলে by/ in case of + Verb + ing বসে।
কিন্তু অন্য Clause- If Clause এর Positive ফলাফল না হলে অর্থাৎ If Clause এর মাধ্যমে অন্য Clause এর কাজটি সম্পাদিত না হলে, by বসালে অর্থ সঙ্গতিপূর্ণ হয় না। তাই এখানে কেবল in case of বসানো যাবে। তাই সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।

English Wizard.question: ১২) Which spelling is correct?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Indegeneous
English Wizard.option3: গ) Indigenous
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Indegenus
English Wizard.exp: Indigenous = স্বদেশী।

English Wizard.question: ১৩) He saved a scanty amount of money so that he could give his wife a nice gift. (make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He saved a scanty amount of money in order for giving his wife a nice gift.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He saved a scanty amount of money in order to giving his wife a nice gift.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He saved a scanty amount of money for giving his wife a nice gift.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He saved a scanty amount of money to give his wife a nice gift.
English Wizard.exp:
Complex Sentence এ so that/ in order that থাকলে Simple করতে হলে to/ in order to + verb এর Base Form বসে। এ হিসেবে (ঘ) সঠিক।
ক- in order for এর ব্যবহার নেই।
খ- in order to এর পর Verb + ing হয় না।
গ- ভাবী কোনো উদ্দেশ্য বুঝানোর জন্য for ব্যবহৃত হয় না।

English Wizard.question: ১৪) He fought bravely in order that he could free his people. (make it compound)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He fought bravely and could free his people.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He fought bravely and freed his people.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He fought bravely so he could free his people.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He wanted to free his people and so he fought bravely.
English Wizard.exp:
So that/in order that থাকলে Compound Sentence এ তিনটি কাজ করতে হয়। যথা-
(1) Clause গুলোর অবস্থান উল্টে যাবে।
(2) ‘want to’ অতিরিক্ত যোগ হবে।
(3) ‘and so/ therefore’ Conjunction যোগ হবে।

English Wizard.question: ১৫) Which word is wrongly spelt?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Remembrance
English Wizard.option3: গ) Resurrection
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Independance
English Wizard.exp:
ambiguous = অস্পষ্ট, দ্ব্যর্থক
remembrance = স্মরণ
resurrection = পুনরুত্থান
independence = স্বাধীনতা

English Wizard.question: ১৬) He could not cross the boundary though he tried heart and soul. (make it compound)
English Wizard.option1: ক) He could not cross the boundary but he tried heart and soul.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He could not cross the boundary and he tried heart and soul.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He tried heart and soul but could not cross the boundary.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He tried heart and soul and could not cross the boundary.
English Wizard.exp: Complex Sentence এ though যদি মাঝে থাকে, তাহলে Compound Sentence এ Though বাদ যাবে এবং though যুক্ত Clause টি প্রথমে বসে, তারপর but বসে। অত:পর অন্য Clause বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৭) He was so obsessed with money that he killed many of his companions to exploit their money. ( Make it compound )
English Wizard.option1: ক) He was too obsessed with money and he killed many of his companions to exploit their money.
English Wizard.option2: খ) He was very obsessed with money and killed many of his companions to exploit their money.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He was so obsessed with money and he killed many of his companions to exploit their money.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He was very obsessed with money but he killed many of his companions to exploit their money.
English Wizard.exp: Complex Sentence এ so ..... that থাকলে Compound Sentence এ very ...... and বসে। এ হিসেবে (খ) সঠিক।

English Wizard.question: ১৮) Which one is correctly spelt?
English Wizard.option2: খ) Vacum
English Wizard.option3: গ) Bureucracy
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Cigarette
English Wizard.exp:
Correct Spelling:

vacuum = শূন্য
bureaucracy = আমলাতন্ত্র

English Wizard.question: ১৯) Which sentence is incorrect?
English Wizard.option1: ক) We should not bow down before an oppressor.
English Wizard.option2: খ) We should abide by our teachers.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He had a great appetite for knowledge.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The liar cowboy at last atoned on his telling lies.

abide by = মেনে চলা

English Wizard.question: ২০) Which sentence is the correct one?
English Wizard.option1: ক) You must compensate to the loss.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Children have fondness of sweets.
English Wizard.option3: গ) He takes pride in his son’s success.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) He persists on his decision.

compensate for = ক্ষতিপূরণ করা
fondness for = আগ্রহ বা পছন্দ থাকা
take pride in = গর্ব করা
persist in = লেগে থাকা, করতে থাকা

English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Schizophrania

English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Inclusion

English Wizard.question: ২৫) Which one is wrongly spelt?

English Wizard.option3: গ) Ascertain

misspell = ভুল বানান করা
